_report_expansion: Expansion forced for reports whose WCL zone is wrong (the expansion is read from the report's zone). LKkhdpbfD6Tq41Q3: Throne of Thunder pulls (Lei Shen, 2026-02-10, ilvl 533) in a report labeled Firelands.
_extras: Complements to the crawl (python -m pipeline.crawl_extra), on eligible pulls already cached. The lists are WCL filters applied at crawl time: after changing one, re-fetch with --refresh. The level 2 Casts table only keeps 5 abilities per player, hence filtered Casts tables: taunts in every pull, compute.json era_consumable_casts in Era pulls. Defensive cooldowns are aura names, own and external, fetched as buff events only on pulls where a player of a compute.json tank_classes class died.
